title: Real conversation
goal: Tell a friend what happened, react while they tell you their news, pass on what people said and keep a chat going.
intro:
This last unit of Part 1 is about the thing you've been working towards: **real conversation**. You'll learn how Gujaratis tell a friend what happened (**ખબર છે, શું થયું?** 'you know what happened?'), how listeners react (**હેં? ખરેખર?**, **હોય નહીં!**, **ગજબ કહેવાય!**), and the little words that keep a chat moving (**આમ તો**, **ખેર**, **ને**, **યાર**).

Two structures let you build longer sentences: **relative clauses** (જે છોકરી કાલે આવી હતી, એ… 'the girl who came yesterday…') and **reported speech** (એણે કહ્યું કે… 'he said that…').

grammar.title: Relative clauses: જે … એ, જ્યારે … ત્યારે, જ્યાં … ત્યાં
grammar.body:
English tucks a 'who/which' clause inside the sentence (*the girl **who came yesterday** is my friend*). Gujarati usually uses a **pair** of words: a **j-word** opens the relative clause, and a matching **e-/t-word** picks it up in the main clause:

**જે** છોકરી કાલે આવી હતી, **એ** મારી બહેનપણી છે — literally 'which girl came yesterday, she is my friend'.

The pairs:
**જે … એ / તે** who, which … he, she, it
**જ્યારે … ત્યારે** when … then
**જ્યાં … ત્યાં** where … there
**જેવું … એવું / તેવું** the way … like that (agrees: જેવો, જેવી)

**જે** takes endings like any pronoun: **જેને** 'to whom', **જેનું** 'whose', **જેણે** (doer with a past transitive verb): **જેણે** આ કર્યું… 'whoever did this…'. The relative clause usually comes **first**. In casual speech the second word is often dropped, or the clause is tucked in after the noun as in English.

The trap: **શું, કોણ, ક્યારે, ક્યાં** are only for questions. 'The man **who** came' is never ~~કોણ આવ્યો~~; it is **જે** માણસ આવ્યો.

examples.en: The boy who came to the party yesterday is my friend.

examples.en: I watched the film you were talking about.

examples.roman: jyāre huṃ pahoṃchyo, tyāre badhā jamtā hatā.
examples.en: When I arrived, everyone was eating. (man speaking)

grammar.title: Passing on what someone said: એણે કહ્યું કે…
grammar.body:
After **કહ્યું કે** 'said that', **પૂછ્યું કે** 'asked', **લાગે છે કે** 'it seems that', Gujarati keeps the **original tense** and often the original words:

Raj: 'હું મોડો આવીશ.' → **રાજે કહ્યું કે એ મોડો આવશે** 'Raj said he'd be late' (the future stays future). In casual speech people even keep the હું: **રાજે કહ્યું કે હું મોડો આવીશ** — context makes it clear.

**Questions**: keep the question word: **એણે પૂછ્યું કે તું ક્યાં છે** 'she asked where you are'. For yes/no questions add **કે નહીં** 'or not': **પૂછ ને કે એ આવશે કે નહીં** 'ask whether he's coming'.

**Gossip form**: **કહેતો હતો / કહેતી હતી કે…** 'he / she was saying that…' is the usual way to pass news on. The quote can also come first, closed with **એમ**: **એ નહીં આવે, એમ કહેતી હતી** 'she was saying she won't come'.

The trap: **કહ્યું** is ergative, so the speaker takes **-એ / -ણે** (રાજે, એણે, મમ્મીએ) and the verb stays **કહ્યું** whoever spoke. The -તો form is not ergative and agrees with the speaker: રાજ **કહેતો** હતો, નિધિ **કહેતી** હતી.

examples.roman: mammīe kahyuṃ ke jamvānuṃ taiyār chhe.
examples.en: Mum said the food is ready.

examples.native: રાજે કહ્યું કે હું મોડો આવીશ.
examples.roman: rāje kahyuṃ ke huṃ moḍo āvīsh.

examples.native: એણે પૂછ્યું કે તું ક્યાં છે.
examples.roman: eṇe pūchhyuṃ ke tuṃ kyāṃ chhe.

examples.native: એ કહેતી હતી કે એને નવી નોકરી મળી ગઈ.
examples.roman: e kahetī hatī ke ene navī nokrī maḷī gaī.
examples.en: She was saying she's got a new job.

examples.native: એ નહીં આવે, એમ કહેતો હતો.
examples.roman: e nahīṃ āve, em kaheto hato.
examples.en: He was saying he won't come.

grammar.title: Telling what happened: story words, reactions and fillers
grammar.body:
**Telling it**: open with **ખબર છે, શું થયું?** or **વાત એમ છે કે…** 'the thing is…', then **પહેલાં** 'first' → **પછી** 'then' → **અચાનક** 'suddenly' → **છેવટે** 'in the end'. Tell it in the simple past (ગયો, થયું, કહ્યું) with the **-તો હતો** form for the background (હું ઘરે જતો હતો 'I was going home').

**Listening**: Gujarati listeners react all the time; silence sounds bored. **હં** / **હા** 'mm-hm' · **પછી?** 'and then?' · **હેં? ખરેખર?** 'what? really?' · **હોય નહીં!** 'no way!' · **ગજબ કહેવાય!** 'amazing!' · **અરે રે!** 'oh dear!' · **બિચારો!** 'poor guy!' · **હદ થઈ ગઈ!** 'that's too much!'

**Fillers**: **મતલબ** / **એટલે કે** 'I mean / so' · **આમ તો** 'actually' · **હા તો** 'so, anyway' (back to the story) · **ખેર** 'anyway' (moving on) · **બાકી** 'apart from that' (new topic) · **…ને?** 'right?'

The trap: **ને** at the end is not 'no'. **તું આવીશ ને?** means 'you'll come, won't you?', and **કહે ને!** means 'go on, tell me!'

examples.native: પહેલાં અમે જમ્યા, પછી ફિલ્મ જોવા ગયા.
examples.roman: pahelāṃ ame jamyā, pachhī film jovā gayā.
examples.en: First we ate, then we went to see a film.

examples.native: હું ઘરે જતો હતો, ત્યારે અચાનક વરસાદ આવ્યો.
examples.roman: huṃ ghare jato hato, tyāre achānak varsād āvyo.
examples.en: I was on my way home when suddenly it started raining.

examples.native: જો કે બહુ ભીડ હતી, પણ મજા આવી.
examples.roman: jo ke bahu bhīḍ hatī, paṇ majā āvī.
examples.en: Although it was very crowded, it was fun.

examples.native: ખેર, એ વાત જવા દે. બાકી શું ચાલે છે?
examples.roman: kher, e vāt javā de. bākī shuṃ chāle chhe?
examples.en: Anyway, forget that. What else is going on?

dialogue.title: The interview
dialogue.setting: Evening, at a tea stall near Law Garden in Ahmedabad. Kunal tells his friend Nidhi about his day.

lines.speaker: Kunal
lines.native: અરે નિધિ! ખબર છે, આજે શું થયું?
lines.roman: are nidhi! khabar chhe, āje shuṃ thayuṃ?
lines.en: Hey Nidhi! You know what happened today?

lines.speaker: Nidhi
lines.native: ના, શું થયું? આખી વાત કહે ને!
lines.roman: nā, shuṃ thayuṃ? ākhī vāt kahe ne!
lines.en: No, what? Go on, tell me everything!

lines.speaker: Kunal
lines.native: સવારે હું ઇન્ટરવ્યૂ માટે જતો હતો, ત્યારે પાર્કિંગમાં એક ભાઈ સાથે ઝઘડો થઈ ગયો.
lines.roman: savāre huṃ inṭarvyū māṭe jato hato, tyāre pārkiṅgmāṃ ek bhāī sāthe jhaghḍo thaī gayo.
lines.en: This morning I was going to my interview, and I got into a fight with some guy in the car park.

lines.speaker: Kunal
lines.native: એણે મારી જગ્યા પર એનું સ્કૂટર મૂકી દીધું. મેં કહ્યું કે આ મારી જગ્યા છે…
lines.roman: eṇe mārī jagyā par enuṃ skūṭar mūkī dīdhuṃ. meṃ kahyuṃ ke ā mārī jagyā chhe…
lines.en: He parked his scooter in my spot. I told him this was my spot…

lines.speaker: Kunal
lines.native: પછી હું ઉપર ગયો, અને જે માણસ ઇન્ટરવ્યૂ લેતો હતો…
lines.roman: pachhī huṃ upar gayo, ane je māṇas inṭarvyū leto hato…
lines.en: Then I went upstairs, and the man who was doing the interview…

lines.speaker: Nidhi
lines.native: હેં! એ જ ભાઈ? તું મજાક કરે છે!
lines.roman: heṃ! e j bhāī? tuṃ majāk kare chhe!
lines.en: What! The same guy? You're kidding!

lines.speaker: Kunal
lines.native: ના, ખરેખર! એણે મને જોઈને હસીને કહ્યું, "બેસો, આ ખુરશી તો તમારી જ છે."
lines.roman: nā, kharekhar! eṇe mane joīne hasīne kahyuṃ, "beso, ā khurshī to tamārī j chhe."
lines.en: No, really! He saw me, smiled and said, "Have a seat, this chair at least is yours."

lines.speaker: Nidhi
lines.native: હા હા! ગજબ કહેવાય! બિચારો તું! તો નોકરી મળી કે નહીં?
lines.roman: hā hā! gajab kahevāy! bichāro tuṃ! to nokrī maḷī ke nahīṃ?
lines.en: Ha ha! Unbelievable! Poor you! So did you get the job or not?

lines.speaker: Kunal
lines.native: ખબર નથી. એ કહેતા હતા કે અઠવાડિયામાં ફોન કરીશું.
lines.roman: khabar nathī. e kahetā hatā ke aṭhvāḍiyāmāṃ fon karīshuṃ.
lines.en: Don't know. He was saying they'd call within a week.

lines.speaker: Nidhi
lines.native: ચાલ, જે થયું એ સારું થયું. હવે ચા પી, ઠંડી થાય છે!
lines.roman: chāl, je thayuṃ e sāruṃ thayuṃ. have chā pī, ṭhaṇḍī thāy chhe!
lines.en: Come on, whatever happened, happened for the best. Now drink your tea, it's getting cold!

culture: In a Gujarati conversation the listener works almost as hard as the speaker: **હં**, **હા**, **પછી? પછી?**, **હેં!**, **હોય નહીં!** Staying silent can sound cold, and jumping in with a reaction is not rude, it shows you're listening. Among friends **યાર** is everywhere, for men and women alike, and in Ahmedabad young people call each other **બકા** ('buddy') or **ભાઈ** / **બેન** whatever their actual relation; teasing (**તું ગાંડો છે કે શું?** 'are you crazy or what?') is a sign of closeness. Switch back to **તમે**, **જી** and no યાર with elders, your friend's parents and anyone you've just met. Urban Gujaratis mix English freely ('Gujlish'): *હું literally shock થઈ ગયો*, *ટેન્શન ના લે* 'don't stress' — perfectly normal. And two very Gujarati reactions: **ચાલશે!** 'it's fine, it'll do' for small disasters, and **મજા આવી ગઈ!** for anything good. From here, Part 2 takes you into real life: making plans, calls, getting around town, eating out and much more.

tip.title: Telling it: પહેલાં → પછી → અચાનક → છેવટે
tip.body:
- Open with **ખબર છે, શું થયું?** or **વાત એમ છે કે…**
- Move it along: **પહેલાં** 'first' → **પછી** 'then' → **અચાનક** 'suddenly' → **છેવટે** 'in the end'.
- Events in the simple past (ગયો, થયું); the background with **-તો હતો**: હું ઘરે **જતો હતો** 'I was going home'.

sentences.roman: ek majāno kisso sāṃbhaḷ. ākhī vāt kahuṃ?

sentences.native: આખી વાત કહે ને! પહેલાં શું થયું?
sentences.roman: ākhī vāt kahe ne! pahelāṃ shuṃ thayuṃ?
sentences.en: Go on, tell me everything! What happened first?

tip.title: React, react, react
tip.body:
- Gujarati listeners keep reacting: **હં**, **પછી?**, **હેં? ખરેખર?** Silence sounds bored.
- Good news: **ગજબ કહેવાય!** · Can't be true: **હોય નહીં!** · Too much: **હદ થઈ ગઈ!**
- Sympathy: **અરે રે!** and **બિચારો** — it agrees: બિચારો રાજ, **બિચારી** નિધિ.

sentences.native: હેં? ખરેખર તને નોકરી મળી ગઈ?
sentences.roman: heṃ? kharekhar tane nokrī maḷī gaī?
sentences.en: What? You really got the job?

sentences.native: ગજબ કહેવાય! એ પણ ગુજરાતી બોલે છે?
sentences.roman: gajab kahevāy! e paṇ gujarātī bole chhe?
sentences.en: Amazing! He speaks Gujarati too?

sentences.native: બિચારી નિધિ! એનું પાકીટ ચોરાઈ ગયું.
sentences.roman: bichārī nidhi! enuṃ pākīṭ chorāī gayuṃ.
sentences.en: Poor Nidhi! Her wallet got stolen.

sentences.native: બિચારો રાજ આખી રાત સૂતો નહીં.
sentences.roman: bichāro rāj ākhī rāt sūto nahīṃ.
sentences.en: Poor Raj didn't sleep all night.

sentences.native: હદ થઈ ગઈ! ફરી તારો ફોન ખોવાઈ ગયો?
sentences.roman: had thaī gaī! farī tāro fon khovāī gayo?
sentences.en: This is too much! You lost your phone again?

sentences.native: અરે! મને વિશ્વાસ નથી થતો, તેં જાતે રાંધ્યું?
sentences.roman: are! mane vishvās nathī thato, teṃ jāte rāṃdhyuṃ?
sentences.en: Oh! I can't believe it, you cooked by yourself?

sentences.native: તું મજાક કરે છે? આ સાડી દસ હજારની?
sentences.roman: tuṃ majāk kare chhe? ā sāḍī das hajārnī?
sentences.en: Are you kidding? This sari cost ten thousand?

sentences.native: હું મજાક નથી કરતી, આ સાચું છે!
sentences.roman: huṃ majāk nathī kartī, ā sāchuṃ chhe!
sentences.en: I'm not kidding, it's true! (woman speaking)

sentences.native: હોય નહીં! તું અને રાજ એક જ શાળામાં ભણ્યા?
sentences.roman: hoy nahīṃ! tuṃ ane rāj ek j shāḷāmāṃ bhaṇyā?
sentences.en: No way! You and Raj went to the same school?

sentences.native: ખરેખર? મને તો ખબર જ નહોતી!
sentences.roman: kharekhar? mane to khabar j nahotī!
sentences.en: Really? I had no idea!

sentences.native: અરે રે! બિચારાં બાળકો વરસાદમાં ભીનાં થઈ ગયાં.
sentences.roman: are re! bichārāṃ bāḷko varsādmāṃ bhīnāṃ thaī gayāṃ.
sentences.en: Oh dear! The poor kids got soaked in the rain.

tip.title: જે … એ — the one who…
tip.body:
- Gujarati uses a pair: **જે** … **એ**: **જે** મિત્ર આવ્યો, **એ** … 'the friend who came…'.
- Same for **જ્યારે … ત્યારે** 'when', **જ્યાં … ત્યાં** 'where', **જેવું … એવું** 'the way…'.
- The relative clause usually comes **first**.
- Not **કોણ / શું / ક્યારે** — those are only for questions.

sentences.native: જે મિત્ર સુરતથી આવ્યો છે, એ આજે અમારે ઘરે જમશે.
sentences.roman: je mitra suratthī āvyo chhe, e āje amāre ghare jamshe.
sentences.en: The friend who's come from Surat is eating at our place today.

sentences.native: જે ફિલ્મ તેં જોઈ, એ કેવી હતી?
sentences.roman: je film teṃ joī, e kevī hatī?
sentences.en: How was the film you saw?

sentences.native: ચાર રસ્તા પર જે દુકાન છે, ત્યાંથી દૂધ લઈ આવ.
sentences.roman: chār rastā par je dukān chhe, tyāṃthī dūdh laī āv.
sentences.en: Get milk from the shop at the crossroads.

sentences.native: જે ગમે, એ લઈ લે.
sentences.roman: je game, e laī le.
sentences.en: Take whatever you like.

sentences.native: જ્યારે તું અમદાવાદ આવે, ત્યારે મને ફોન કરજે.
sentences.roman: jyāre tuṃ amdāvād āve, tyāre mane fon karje.
sentences.en: When you come to Ahmedabad, give me a call.

sentences.native: જ્યારે હું નાની હતી, ત્યારે અમે વડોદરામાં રહેતાં.
sentences.roman: jyāre huṃ nānī hatī, tyāre ame vaḍodarāmāṃ rahetāṃ.
sentences.en: When I was little, we lived in Vadodara. (woman speaking)

sentences.native: જ્યાં સારી ચા મળે, ત્યાં જઈએ.
sentences.roman: jyāṃ sārī chā maḷe, tyāṃ jaīe.
sentences.en: Let's go wherever we can get good tea.

sentences.native: જેવી ચા મમ્મી બનાવે છે, એવી કોઈ નથી બનાવતું.
sentences.roman: jevī chā mammī banāve chhe, evī koī nathī banāvtuṃ.
sentences.en: Nobody makes tea the way Mum does.

sentences.native: જોરદાર! જે ફોન તેં લીધો, એ બહુ સરસ છે.
sentences.roman: jordār! je fon teṃ līdho, e bahu saras chhe.
sentences.en: Awesome! The phone you bought is really nice.

sentences.native: કાલની મૅચ જોરદાર હતી!
sentences.roman: kālnī mech jordār hatī!
sentences.en: Yesterday's match was awesome!

tip.title: એણે કહ્યું કે… — keep the tense
tip.body:
- **કહ્યું કે / પૂછ્યું કે** + what was said, in its **original tense**: રાજે કહ્યું કે એ મોડો **આવશે**.
- **કહ્યું** is ergative: રાજ**ે**, એ**ણે**, મમ્મી**એ** કહ્યું — the verb never changes.
- Gossip form: **કહેતો હતો / કહેતી હતી કે…** agrees with the speaker.
- Yes/no questions: **… કે નહીં** 'whether'.
tip.pattern: X-એ કહ્યું કે …  ·  X કહેતો / કહેતી હતો કે …

sentences.native: એણે કહ્યું કે એ રસ્તામાં છે.
sentences.roman: eṇe kahyuṃ ke e rastāmāṃ chhe.
sentences.en: He said he's on his way.

sentences.native: મમ્મી પૂછતી હતી કે તું ક્યારે આવશે.
sentences.roman: mammī pūchhtī hatī ke tuṃ kyāre āvshe.
sentences.en: Mum was asking when you're coming.

sentences.native: રાજ કહેતો હતો કે કાલે રજા છે.
sentences.roman: rāj kaheto hato ke kāle rajā chhe.
sentences.en: Raj was saying that tomorrow's a holiday.

sentences.native: મેં એને પૂછ્યું કે ટ્રેન કેટલા વાગ્યે છે.
sentences.roman: meṃ ene pūchhyuṃ ke ṭren keṭlā vāgye chhe.
sentences.en: I asked him what time the train is.

sentences.native: નિધિને પૂછ ને કે એ જમવા આવશે કે નહીં.
sentences.roman: nidhine pūchh ne ke e jamvā āvshe ke nahīṃ.
sentences.en: Go on, ask Nidhi whether she's coming for dinner or not.

sentences.native: એ જૂઠું બોલ્યો કે એ બીમાર છે.
sentences.roman: e jūṭhuṃ bolyo ke e bīmār chhe.
sentences.en: He lied that he was ill.

sentences.native: એ લોકો તારા વિશે વાત કરતા હતા.
sentences.roman: e loko tārā vishe vāt kartā hatā.
sentences.en: They were talking about you.

sentences.native: એ કાલે નહીં આવે, એમ કહેતી હતી.
sentences.roman: e kāle nahīṃ āve, em kahetī hatī.
sentences.en: She was saying she won't come tomorrow.

sentences.native: મતલબ, તું નથી આવતો?
sentences.roman: matlab, tuṃ nathī āvto?
sentences.en: I mean, you're not coming? (to a man)

sentences.native: એટલે કે આપણે કાલે નહીં મળીએ?
sentences.roman: eṭle ke āpaṇe kāle nahīṃ maḷīe?
sentences.en: So you mean we won't meet tomorrow?

tip.title: Little words that keep it moving
tip.body:
- **આમ તો** 'actually' sets up a 'but'. **ખેર** 'anyway' moves on. **બાકી** 'apart from that' opens a new topic.
- **ને?** at the end = 'right?': તું આવીશ **ને**? After a command it coaxes: કહે **ને**!
- **યાર** with friends only — never with elders.
- **વચ્ચે ના બોલ** 'don't interrupt'.

sentences.native: તું કાલે આવીશ ને?
sentences.roman: tuṃ kāle āvīsh ne?
sentences.en: You'll come tomorrow, won't you?

sentences.native: બાકી બધું બરાબર? ઘરે બધા કેમ છે?
sentences.roman: bākī badhuṃ barābar? ghare badhā kem chhe?
sentences.en: Everything else OK? How is everyone at home?

sentences.native: આમ તો હું નહોતો જવાનો, પણ મિત્રોએ આગ્રહ કર્યો.
sentences.roman: ām to huṃ nahoto javāno, paṇ mitroe āgrah karyo.
sentences.en: Actually I wasn't going to go, but my friends insisted.

sentences.native: ખેર, બીજી વાત કરીએ.
sentences.roman: kher, bījī vāt karīe.
sentences.en: Anyway, let's talk about something else.

sentences.native: જો કે ભીડ બહુ હતી, પણ મજા આવી.
sentences.roman: jo ke bhīḍ bahu hatī, paṇ majā āvī.
sentences.en: Although it was really crowded, it was fun.

sentences.native: વચ્ચે ના બોલ, યાર! પહેલાં આખી વાત સાંભળ.
sentences.roman: vachche nā bol, yār! pahelāṃ ākhī vāt sāṃbhaḷ.
sentences.en: Don't interrupt, man! Listen to the whole thing first.

sentences.native: હા તો, હું ક્યાં હતો? અરે હા, પછી એ ગુસ્સે થઈ ગયો.
sentences.roman: hā to, huṃ kyāṃ hato? are hā, pachhī e gusse thaī gayo.
sentences.en: So, where was I? Oh yes, then he got angry.

sentences.native: બીજું શું ચાલે છે, યાર?
sentences.roman: bījuṃ shuṃ chāle chhe, yār?
sentences.en: What else is going on, man?

sentences.native: બાકી, નોકરી કેવી ચાલે છે?
sentences.roman: bākī, nokrī kevī chāle chhe?
sentences.en: Apart from that, how's the job going?

sentences.native: આમ તો ગુજરાતી સહેલી છે ને?
sentences.roman: ām to gujarātī sahelī chhe ne?
sentences.en: Gujarati is actually easy, isn't it?

tip.title: Teasing and laughing
tip.body:
- **મને હસવું આવ્યું** 'I couldn't help laughing' works like મને ભૂખ લાગી: the laugh 'comes to' you.
- **ગાંડો** agrees: તું **ગાંડો** છે? (man), **ગાંડી** (woman). Friends only!
- Shrug off a small disaster: **ચાલશે!** **જવા દે, યાર.**

sentences.native: એની વાત સાંભળીને મને બહુ હસવું આવ્યું.
sentences.roman: enī vāt sāṃbhaḷīne mane bahu hasvuṃ āvyuṃ.
sentences.en: I laughed so much when I heard what he said.

sentences.roman: tuṃ gāṃḍo chhe ke shuṃ?
sentences.en: Are you crazy or what? (to a man)

sentences.native: એ ગાંડી છે, રાત્રે બે વાગ્યે ચા પીવા ગઈ!
sentences.roman: e gāṃḍī chhe, rātre be vāgye chā pīvā gaī!
sentences.en: She's crazy, she went out for tea at two in the morning!

sentences.native: જવા દે, યાર, એ તો મજાક હતી.
sentences.roman: javā de, yār, e to majāk hatī.
sentences.en: Forget it, man, it was only a joke.

sentences.native: આખી રાત બધા બહુ હસ્યા.
sentences.roman: ākhī rāt badhā bahu hasyā.
sentences.en: Everyone laughed a lot all night.

sentences.native: ગરબા જોરદાર હતા, મજા આવી ગઈ!
sentences.roman: garbā jordār hatā, majā āvī gaī!
sentences.en: The garba was awesome, it was so much fun!

sentences.native: મોડું થયું? ચાલશે, કોઈ વાંધો નહીં.
sentences.roman: moḍuṃ thayuṃ? chālshe, koī vāṃdho nahīṃ.
sentences.en: You're late? That's fine, no problem.

sentences.native: મારા પર ના હસ, યાર!
sentences.roman: mārā par nā has, yār!
sentences.en: Don't laugh at me, man!

sentences.native: એ મજાક કરતો હતો, ગુસ્સે ના થા.
sentences.roman: e majāk karto hato, gusse nā thā.
sentences.en: He was only joking, don't get angry.
